newsitem.title: USA: Sprint no comment on Cable&Wireless bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Sprint no comment on Cable&Wireless bid talk.

text.p: Sprint Corp declined to comment on Wednesday on a report that British telecommunications firm Cable & Wireless Plc was contemplating making a bid for the company.
The Wall Street Journal reported that Cable & Wireless had held talks with 10-percent Sprint owner France Telecom to garner support for a bid which could be worth more than $15 billion.
The bid would be for the 80 percent of Sprint not already owned by France Telecom and Germany's Deutsche Telekom AG, which also owned 10 percent, the paper said.
"We do not comment on rumors or speculation," a Sprint spokeswoman told Reuters.
Earlier, Cable & Wireless declined to comment on the report and France Telecom denied it had held talks with Cable & Wireless about an increase of its stake in Sprint.
"We are very happy with the 20 percent we own in Sprint with Deutsche Telekom," the France Telecom spokesman said.
But he said that France Telecom had held talks with Cable & Wireless regarding Global One, the French firm's alliance with Deutsche Telekom and Sprint.
